scientific_integrity.claim_scope: Complete global minimization of Gaussian posterior integral variance over two arbitrary point sites for a stationary exponential kernel and positive independent equal observation-noise variances.
limitations: Two sites only, uniform interval integration, stationary exponential kernel, independent equal positive noise, known zero GP mean.
No deterministic worst-case complexity or practical speedup claim.
An early original exact integral-design paper and a noiseless design research record were not fully accessible; historical priority risk remains.
Independent audit and validation have not been performed.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Exact two-by-two Gaussian conditioning; globally strict fixed-separation reflection-centering inequality; unique stationary-point equation; algebraic trisection simplification.

title: Noise-universal trisection for two-site exponential-kernel quadrature
